mutations.M3: M3 ILLEGAL INVERSION: exactly FOUR things are inverted -- det5, the E220 pivot -5*a*t, the block-3 unit beta = -(5/8)*a**4*c, and the rational Gaussian pivots at the F5 point. mutations.M5: M5 BODY TAMPER: a DECLARED +1 perturbation of the frozen E321 on the a**4*c*c7_5 coefficient (present, value -5/8) moves beta, so the syzygy generator (1, -(3/2)*a*t) stops annihilating the column and the whole module stops being block-triangular with a rank-one last block. mutations.M6: M6 NO PROMOTION IN EITHER DIRECTION: this lane clears no face, represents no source, empties no stratum and closes no wall.
